g.text: Local inland cross-sections: legacy, current, and three hill candidates
Same coordinates; heights relative to each 512-square inland median. Common vertical scale: -40 to +40 blocks.
Only land with coast >=96 and zero mountain uplift is plotted. Gaps exclude coastal ramps and water.
